context: Asuka lectures on categories and criteria.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: lecture; formal connectives (基準/いわゆる/または/要素/含め) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 分類には、明確な基準が必要です。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 基準は、形または色で決めますか?
lines.en: Do we set criteria by form or color?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 形または機能、両方の要素を見ます。
lines.en: We look at both form or function, both elements.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いわゆる例外も、含めるんですか?
lines.en: Do we include the so-called exceptions too?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 例外を含めて、基準を考えます。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 大事な要素は、何でしょうか?
lines.style: engaged adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いわゆる共通点が、最も重要な要素です。
lines.en: The so-called common point is the most important element.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 基準を含めて、よく整理できました。
lines.en: Including the criteria, I organized it well.
lines.style: satisfied adult student voice, soft warm appreciative throughout
